summary_1line: Bhishma teaches that kings thrive through partnership with Brahmanas and righteous rule, illustrated by Muchukunda’s encounter with Vaisravana and duties of a just king.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Muchukunda stands amid the battlefield as hordes of Rakshasas overwhelm his army, while the sage Vasishtha prepares through ascetic power to destroy them.
The radiant lord of wealth Vaisravana appears before the fearless king Muchukunda during the battle and addresses him amid the falling Rakshasa troops.
A just king sits armed on his throne while Brahmanas perform sacred rites beside him, symbolizing the union of spiritual power and royal force protecting the realm.
